enphase-2021.every_line: Read line by line against Enphase's FY2021 10-K (accession 0001463101-22-000016), the original the acquisition saved. Every line is a bold stand-alone line of Item 1A: the seven category headings (Risks Related to our Business, Operations and Our Industry; to our Intellectual Property and Technology; to Legal Proceedings and Regulations; to Our Financial Condition and Liquidity; to our Acquisition Activity; to our Debt and Equity Securities; General Risks Related to our Business) and, under them, the sixty-one sentences that open each risk factor and stand apart from its body. Each is a heading of Item 1A under the approved definition's heading-level list, the same judgement made for the FY2025 report. The reading finds no heading-marked line the route left out, and no line emphasis resumes after a short gap.
